newsitem.title: UK: UK's Labour to open election campaign on Tuesday.
newsitem.headline: UK's Labour to open election campaign on Tuesday.

text.p: Britain's opposition Labour Party will formally open its election campaign with a press conference at 1030 GMT on Tuesday at its Millbank Tower media centre.
Labour leader Tony Blair, finance spokesman Gordon Brown, trade and industry spokeswoman Margaret Beckett, and education and employment spokesman David Blunkett will be present.
Prime Minister John Major announced on Monday the election will be held on May 1.
